channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Erdoğan to unveil new family policy amid population concerns
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan is set to announce a national family policy directive on Feb. 17 aimed at strengthening both family structures and population growth, local media have reported.

item.title: A brand story from home kitchen to world
item.description: Founded by Lebanese entrepreneur Mireille Hayek, Em Sherif’s story traces how a home-kitchen tradition evolved into a global gastronomic brand by turning memory, adaptability and female leadership into its strongest ingredients

item.title: Istanbul’s hamams boost winter tourism, strengthen local economy
item.description: Turkish baths, or hamams, are playing an increasingly visible role in Istanbul’s economy, buoyed by rising interest from foreign visitors and younger generations, according to sector representatives.

item.title: Business leaders urge EU to unlock customs union update
item.description: Turkish and European business leaders have urged the European Union to reopen the path to Türkiye’s membership bid, modernize the EU-Türkiye Customs Union and deepen cooperation in an open letter addressed to EU leaders.

item.title: NATO’s ability to deter Russia takes a hit
item.description: European allies and Canada are pouring billions of dollars into helping Ukraine, and they have pledged to massively boost their budgets to defend their territories.

item.title: Israel partially reopens Gaza's Rafah crossing
item.description: Israel partially reopened the Rafah crossing between the devastated Gaza Strip and Egypt on Feb. 1 following months of urging from humanitarian organizations, though access is limited to the movement of people.

item.title: Oil tumbles on Iran hopes, precious metals hit by stronger dollar
item.description: Oil prices tanked on Monday on easing U.S.-Iran tensions while precious metals swung wildly following last week's dollar-fuelled collapse sparked by Donald Trump's hawkish pick to lead the Federal Reserve.

item.title: Ukraine war talks delayed to Wednesday, says Zelensky
item.description: A second round of talks between Russian, Ukrainian and U.S. officials on a U.S.-drafted plan to end the nearly four-year Ukraine war will begin on Wednesday, instead of Sunday, President Volodymyr Zelensky said.

item.title: Syria, SDF set to launch integration process under new deal
item.description: The implementation of a new deal between the Syrian government and the Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) is set to begin on Feb. 2 after the two sides consolidated a ceasefire that ended weeks of fighting and laid out a gradual roadmap for integration.

item.title: Trump hopeful of Iran deal after Tehran warns of regional war
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday said he was hopeful of agreeing a deal with Iran after the country's supreme leader warned that any U.S. attack on the Islamic republic would trigger a regional war.
